text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Ahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (I feel it, I feel it! Mayano is coming! Laurel, Brian, and everyone else too!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Ahahaha★☆
Ahahahaha★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Can you tell? Is it reaching you?
—This fleeting miracle!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Right here, right now, all of us!
Betting our dreams, our feelings, our resolve, our pride,
every single bit of it, to compete against one another!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (Hey! Is that really—)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus!☆★

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel is 1st! Sakura Laurel has
brilliantly conquered the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
Full cherry blossoms bloom over the spring of Yodo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... haah.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah—fufu, ahahaha!!
Fufu, amazing... I've never experienced a race like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "I've never had this much fun in a race before...!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Ahaha, ahahahaha...!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Aah! It's amazing, so amazing!!
My legs feel like they can't take another step,
I'm completely out of breath, and my heart's about to burst!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Everyyything is... maaarvelous...☆
Ahahahaha...★"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Mave-chin collapsed!?
Oh no—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Still, guess not! Ahaha.
Mave-chin's always smiling, after all!
You're probably just a little tired."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Aw man! I lost!!
And look at Laurel-san,
smiling and having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Still... Maya ended up having a ton of fun running too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...When I run with Mave-chin,
I can definitely keep from forgetting."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Racing is fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after helping Marvelous Sunday up
and making our way back to the underground walkway...
choice_data_list: Marvelous, are you okay? Take a little rest—
Marvelous, are you alright? Take a little rest—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Huh? Wait a sec?
Is this—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: A marvelous presence...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That would be your name.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Brian! It's Brian!!
Wait, this Marvelous is Brian!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't know.
...I only came to talk for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Talk? With me?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
To you, who stood at the very center of today's race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "...It was a race akin to a wild frenzy. Not a single person looked down halfway through. Every last one of them looked forward—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, everyone was enjoying the race
to the point of flashing ferocious grins.
...Enjoying the fight for victory.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...And so too, was my joy.
Or rather... my very reason for living.
I felt that, without a doubt, it was right here."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I thought as much, so I came to make sure.
...And I confirmed it, even more than I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I will live right here—in the races.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ! Brian—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She will likely never run the same way again.
She may make a disgraceful display of herself and throw a tantrum.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, I will retrain. And I will keep running.
...For my true joy lies right here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Running with you all today made me realize it. And it made me resolve myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —I give you my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian!!
Hey, does that mean in the race, Marvelous was—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Is it because my marvelousness reached them?
No, but could this be...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wondering why she had suddenly gone quiet, I guided her back to the waiting room. There, her rivals were waiting for her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —I see, so you had that kind of conversation with Brian-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but...
I think I might understand what she's saying too.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Really? Laurel, too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Hey, Mabe-chan, you know...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Before summer, I'm heading out of Japan.
—I'm running in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because racing with you was so much fun, Mabe-chan.
That's why—to have even more fun running with you,
to keep on running, I have to become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to hesitate.
I've gotta step forward with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Laurel—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya too! Maya too, Maya too!!
Maya's gonna get way stronger too!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Because I realized I could be even more excited!
That I could shine even brighter!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What should I do~?
Brian-san's gonna train super hard, so...
Maybe Maya will tag along too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, Mave-chin! Once I become an even sparklier me—let's race again!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mayano...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt I could be sure of it.
'Sharing the Marvelous through racing.'
Her longtime dream was finally—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It reached her rivals,
and bore fruit within each of their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
…………
Yes. Yes, it's marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yet, this was even more than that—☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Nope☆
I'm sure the time will come when you understand...★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So let's wait!
My heart's pounding and I'm itching to go!!
But let's wait☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're not just waiting around, are you?!
Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Laurel is taking flight!!
Mayano and Brian are getting stronger!!
So I have to, too—
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best at the Takarazuka Kinen!
Yeah, let's do our best at the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mm☆★☆
It's the finale of the Spring Senior Triple Crown, isn't it?!
